approvers: Developer or main contractor, who set what protection the subcontract package requires and who pays
reason: The subcontract package tells me what protection I must provide and who pays for it, and nobody has asked for this. I don't buy it today, and a 50% deposit goes against how I pay.
objection: We pay suppliers at 60 to 90 days, not deposits up front. Around €19 per m² is also a new cost on small house jobs. The developer would have to pay it, and I won't take it out of my margin.
instead: Cardboard, cheap protection film and tape from the hardware store, and cleaning the frames before handover, as we do now.
would_change_my_mind: A developer or main contractor putting this in the subcontract package and paying for it, with 60-day terms and no deposit.
